calendarInfo: If you would like to download any of the dates listed below to your electronic calendar you can do so via the school calendar in the Parents section of the School Website.
poolCampaign: Our beloved pool needs an upgrade! Our pool was hand dug by parents and teachers in the 1970s and has been a vital facility for all these years. Help us finish the update by donating here.
kumonInfo: We have a referral partnership with Kumon. When you enrol your child, mention the Aldryngton PTA referral to benefit the school and your family. Referral Code: CXFDS3. £20 voucher per enrolled student for the PTA. Waiver of £55 registration fee for your child.
otherSchemes: Many employers offer match funding schemes that can double your fundraising contributions. Raise money for the PTA every time you shop online through Easy Fundraising.
